Lemma
[preservation of three-dimensional Ricci pinching] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 5.2.4\group Differentiable Sphere Theorems

For any $\varepsilon \in [0,\frac{1}{3}]$, the pinching condition \[ R_{ij}\geq 0\ \ \ and\ \ \ R_{ij}\geq \varepsilon Rg_{ij} \] is preserved by the Ricci flow.
